M-TRACE.NAME: Traceability report
M-TRACE.purpose: Answer "why does this module exist, what proves it and what breaks if I change it?" in one bounded read, with stable gap codes (Wave 3.2).
M-TRACE.annotations: <export-traceCommand PURPOSE="mygrace trace [--module M-XXX] [--path] [--format text|json]; exit 1 on chain errors." />

CrossLink.relation: module and verification lookups read the shard-transparent union
command provenance and the trust-gating verdict mirror test/verify

contract.purpose: Trace one module's full traceability chain and expose gaps as stable findings without executing anything.

param.name: result
param.description: module, verification, testFiles, command, requirements, phases, dependents, findings, exitCode.

contract.errors: <error code="NO_DECLARED_COMMAND" description="No , no module fallback and only the config/default runner (info)." />

notes.note-1: Read-only: no file writes, no project-command execution; the trust verdict is reported, never acted on.
notes.note-2: Partial projects stay usable: optional links (requirements, phases) are info findings and do not change the exit code.
notes.note-3: Command provenance is explicit: verification | module-deprecated | config | default, plus requiresShellOptIn for shell-style commands.
